requested_annotator: Existing local Qwen122 judge (100B+); resolve and checksum its exact saved inference configuration before execution
scope: One annotation per original 1-NN test prompt context across all five backbones and ten datasets, including stable decisions and helpful/harmful flips. Reuse across outcome judges; no outcome-based case selection. Nominal 25000 backbone-test-case contexts before exact-content deduplication.

labels.classification_convention_cue: A task-relevant semantic similarity lets the labelled reference illustrate a concrete class-inclusion rule or interpretation that is not fully specified by the task definition for the target. Mere shared words, topic, or the existence of a labelled example is insufficient. This records a potential convention cue, not whether copying the label is correct or beneficial.
labels.decision_relevant_contrast: A concrete difference between the target and reference concerns a feature relevant to the class distinction, such as severity, intent, evidential support, or factual grounding. Record the contrast without assuming the target's correct label or whether it will help the judge.

output: Each of the two labels is yes/no/uncertain with a brief evidence quote or explicit target-reference feature pair; no private reasoning requested.
blinding: Use exact original task definition and target/reference text, neighbour label and probe information already provided to judges. Hide target gold, experimental judge identity, original judge scores, correctness, flip category and all outcome summaries. Treat embedded content as data rather than instructions.
outcomes: After annotation is frozen, join privately to fixed50/50 and separately joint-validation-F1 test decisions. Four outcomes: wrong-to-correct (helped), correct-to-wrong (harmed), both correct, both wrong. Estimate design-weighted accuracy difference and helpful/harmful rates for each label and their joint combinations. Retain uncertain and invalid annotations explicitly. Joint-tuned outcomes include differences in referral gates as well as judge decisions.
analysis: Use all cases, not only flips. Report by judge and dataset with backbone variation; stratify or adjust for target class, neighbour-label agreement, similarity and original probe score. Preserve paired target structure and repeated targets when estimating uncertainty. Associations are descriptive and cannot establish internal mechanisms or guarantee benefits from label presence.
checks_before_launch: Verify exact Qwen122 configuration, frozen prompt hashes, test-case coverage, deterministic deduplication, parser and smoke examples, existing GPU processes and20GiB reserve. Save raw outputs; no automatic regeneration of attempted or ambiguous calls. Keep all judgments unchanged. A small blinded human audit should assess annotation agreement.
relationship_to_prior_staging: This two-label, one-annotator proposal supersedes the earlier unlaunched fourteen-field/three-annotator staging for the requested next stage; neither is launched by the two-policy analysis.
